name: dry_run:log-payment-app-debug:a5fdad12
query:
fetch logs, from: -24h, samplingRatio: 100
| filter service.name == "payment"
| summarize scope_records = count() * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    target_records = countIf(service.name == "payment" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "DEBUG") * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    matched_records = countIf(service.name == "payment" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "DEBUG") * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    outside_target = countIf((service.name == "payment" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "DEBUG") and not (service.name == "payment" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "DEBUG")) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    matched_errors = countIf((service.name == "payment" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "DEBUG") and in(loglevel, {"ERROR", "FATAL"})) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio)
